Shumsk New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Classified as demolished, yet this cemetery's own condition notes describe a fenced, only slightly overgrown site in excellent condition — another contradiction worth flagging rather than resolving. It served a community that, remarkably, made up nearly 87 percent of Shumsk's population by 1897, predominantly followers of the Olyka and Trisk Hasidic courts. Only 15 Jews survived after the ghetto's Jews were executed in two mass actions in August and September 1942; part of the cemetery's eastern section, visible on earlier maps, appears to have since been demolished and built over.
